title: governed register: `.claude/**` is Tier S for objectui, but objectui's queue guard refuses an objectui `.claude/**` PR without an approval, so `check-governed-merges --pr` gives the wrong landing route and the relay never requests the approvers
body:
Filing gate **①**: a defect with a named site and a reproduction. Filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 3 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#9800) · `session_019Bd3muSBdHUFdJiKqnsM2W` (`os-sales`), landing objectstack-ai/objectui#13320. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and routing are triage's.

## The two readings of one PR

objectstack-ai/objectui#13320 changes six files, all under `.claude/hooks/`:

- objectstack `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr objectstack-ai/objectui#13320` (objectstack `origin/main` `2069b81c2`) answers **`GOVERNED — Tier S(席内达档复核落地)`**: the seat lands it through the queue on a `## Contract review` PASS, "and no maintainer click is waited for".
- objectui `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the same six paths (objectui head `8a0c369`) answers **`GOVERNED`, exit 3**: "The merge-queue run of "Governed Surface Queue Guard" refuses this diff unless an APPROVED review by an authorized approver (GOVERNED_APPROVERS: os-zhuang, hotlong) is on the pull request". objectui's guard has no Tier S.

The guard that runs on objectui's `merge_group` is objectui's. A seat that follows objectstack's register readies the PR and enqueues it, and the queue then rejects it.

## Site

`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`, the `GOVERNED_SURFACES` row `id: 'claude-tree'` (`glob: '.claude/**', tier: GOVERNED_TIER_S`). It has no `repos` field, so the Tier S reading applies to every governed repo. The `workflows` row in the same table shows the per-repo `repos` form already exists.

## Second effect: no review request

`scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` `governedReviewRequests` sends the `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` review request only on a Tier H hit ("A Tier S diff (`.claude/**` alone …) and an ungoverned diff send nothing"). On objectstack-ai/objectui#13320, `GET …/pulls/13320/requested_reviewers` read `[]` after `pr_create`. The seat asked for `hotlong` and `os-zhuang` by hand with `pr_request_reviewers`.

## Not decided here

Whether objectui's `.claude/**` should be Tier S (objectui's guard gains a Tier S arm) or Tier H (objectstack's register scopes the `claude-tree` row by repo) is a choice of route. The enforced guard today is objectui's, and objectui's lane file `references/lanes/ui.md` already tells the seat to stop at draft for an approval. The seat followed that, the stricter of the two rules.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, "objectui governed .claude Tier S landingTierOf queue guard approval disagree": 10 hits, all closed, none this shape (nearest: #19133, the Tier S/H split; #18020, an objectstack-side declared-not-enforced tier). objectui, "Tier S objectui .claude hooks needs authorized approval governed queue guard": 2 hits, neither this.

Dedupe words: claude-tree Tier S objectui, governedReviewRequests objectui, check-governed-merges objectui queue guard.
